ShortDescription.Value: Roads take time to build and demolish, with a real trench, working machines, closures and staged opening.

Publish.LongDescription:
Road building becomes real road works. A new road no longer appears the moment you release the mouse: it is surveyed, dug out, given a gravel foundation, paved and marked, while machines work at believable speeds. Bulldozing a road starts a demolition that breaks it up, removes the road bed and restores the ground.
**Construction** - Roads take in-game time (48 working hours per km by default, at least 6 hours). Crews work around the clock. - Five visible phases: survey & clearing, excavation, foundation, paving, markings & finishing. - A real trench is dug into the terrain, with dirt, gravel and fresh asphalt textures. - Long roads are split into sections, each with its own crew.
**Demolition** - Breaking up, removing the road bed and restoring the ground to its original shape. - Bulldozing a new road that has only just been started removes it at once with a full refund.
**Machines** - Excavators really dig and load dump trucks bucket by bucket. - A grading excavator spreads the gravel, tandem rollers compact the base and the asphalt, and a paver and a line painter finish the road. - Realistic speeds, no driving through each other, work lights at night.
**Traffic** - Sites are closed and traffic reroutes. The road opens only after every machine has left. - Staged opening: sidewalks open from paving, then one direction opens during the markings with yellow temporary lines, fences, cones, signs and blinking beacons.
**Interface** - A Road works panel with phases, progress, finish time, crews, traffic status, cost and refund, and Rush, Cancel and Show work front buttons. - Tooltips with the expected work time while you draw or bulldoze roads.
**Save safe** - Only one small component per road segment is saved. Without the mod, a save loads with normal, open roads. - Uses only the game's own assets.
Known limitations: elevated roads, bridges and tunnels get a simple site without a trench. Every car lane in the game is one-way, so there is no alternating traffic light.
Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/jasperaelvoet/realistic-road-works
Publish.ChangeLog: 3.3.0: during a road upgrade the old road, its junctions and connections stay until the works are done; the upgraded road appears at the finishing. Every upgrade ends with re-marking: on roads with two or more lanes per direction the painting crew works on the move and only the lanes beside it close over a short moving stretch. The works start right at the old kerb, small kerb shifts need no works, ground textures no longer slide, and the yellow lines join the road's own markings.
